scope: Real-model resource and update-derivative profile only; no Dice scoring or formal experiment
comparison_note: R46 original includes W and LSO; C_JS_SHARED is the matched C-background R46 filter mechanism
measurement: Synchronized wall time and CUDA events around Host.step; identical read-only Adam observation hooks for all conditions. Derivative aggregation and image decode excluded from per-step timings but included in worker cost.
checkpoint: Existing migrated RIM_ONE_r3 Res_Unet source state; no source images or labels
input_selection: First 32 arrivals of each original image-only stream, fixed before runtime; no output-based selection
publication: Own source/protocol and anonymous aggregates/cost/audit only; raw steps, image identities, predictions, model states and private paths remain private
limitations: Short previously exposed prefixes only; shared-GPU timing can be noisy. This qualifies implementation and resource cost, not Dice benefit, anatomical protection or full-stream numerical safety.
